audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining cooldown is written as the literal word 'Ultimate' everywhere — focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], the loading tips — with no name, range or timer.
audit.why: His ultimate is Grim Deliverance: 600 range, 110/95/80s, and it heals him for a portion of damage dealt. A player told to 'track Ultimate' has nothing to count.
audit.corrected: focus.text now names Grim Deliverance and dosFull[0].d carries the 600 range, the 110/95/80s cooldown and the heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names on the page do not exist: 'E Golden Onslaught' and 'R Final Retribution' (in wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2], spikes[2].text and content.mid). Four applicable interactions were absent entirely: the Q auto-reset tell, the Q recast knockup, the E dash being wall-deniable, and his Q/R healing needing Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Per the repo's own interaction data his E is Aureate Rush (a dash, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, percent-health) and his R is Grim Deliverance. Riot's Q text: he slashes twice on his next attack and heals, and can recast so the next attack knocks up — an auto reset with a delayed displacement.
audit.corrected: Both invented names replaced in all four fields; the do/don't bodies now carry the reset tell, the recast knockup, the E dash cooldown to wall, and the grave-banking rule. Anti-heal moved into wants.you[0].
